brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases piece:0,0,0 to piece:3,0,0 in a straight row, each with a drained third-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain ... bin:3,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain), soil-filled and planted (prop:1-4, visible from above).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 laid at level 0 through cells (0,0)-(1,0)-(2,0)-(3,0) before the bins were placed, so it passes straight through every base.

Run set to mode irrigation and passes through all four cells, each cell carrying a drained bin over it. The configurator checks fit only, not waterproofing or actual water delivery, so real feeding/watertightness cannot be verified here.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell planter in a straight row: four full bases with an irrigation-mode pipe run (run:run-1) laid through all bases at level 0, each cell fitted with a compatibly-offered drained third-depth bin, soil-filled and planted. Open faces capped and joints locked per house rules. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no prop warnings. Note the pipe-through-cell rule limited bins to third-depth; real water delivery/waterproofing is outside what the configurator can verify.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
